name: The AubreyRose Tea Room
notes: The entire published menu is two per-person prix-fixe packages -- Afternoon Tea ($45.95/adult, $41.95/child; holiday pricing $59.95/$55.95) and Cream Tea ($24.95/person) -- with no itemized per-dish prices anywhere on the page; explicit note on the page says 'Price is per person regardless of party size'. Address on the page (8362 La Mesa Blvd, La Mesa, CA 91942) matches the work list. The only other individually priced lines are drinks (House Champagne/Mimosa/Sparkling Cider $11/glass, BYO corkage $20/bottle), not food dishes. This is the buffet/all-inclusive-price pattern the playbook calls out as not_found rather than blocked.

notes: Router's HTTPS fetch failed on a TLS handshake error; the domain cotijasmexgrillandseafoodca.com now points to a generic 'FromTheRestaurant' app-download parked page (not the real restaurant site). The restaurant's genuine online-ordering storefront on that same platform (FOX Ordering / fromtherestaurant.com, first-party -- header image is literally cotijas-mex-grill-and-seafood-bk.jpg) is reachable directly and confirms name, address (3695 Fairmount Ave, San Diego CA 92105) and phone (619-521-1974) verbatim against the work list. 'Online ordering currently unavailable' banner is a front-end gate; the full priced catalog is still served (same pattern as a gated Clover/DoorDash storefront). Ran the divisor sweep (1.04/1.10/1.15/1.17/1.20/1.25/1.30) across 41 sampled prices -- best was 1.30 at 27%, well under the markup threshold, and the raw cent distribution (.00/.50/.95/.99/.49) is entirely conventional printed-menu style, so filed as read. One row with no item name attached to a $4.00 price (a rolled-taco variant, duplicate of the description text above it) was dropped rather than guessed. Kids Menu, Drinks and Desserts are adjunct-adjacent but included since they're priced per-item on the same first-party menu.
